name: Apollo
summary: A general-purpose humanoid from Apptronik, a University of Texas at Austin spin-off whose founders previously worked on NASA's Valkyrie. Apollo uses force-controlled linear actuators for safe operation around people and swappable batteries for continuous shifts. It has run pilots with Mercedes-Benz and GXO, and Apptronik partnered with Google DeepMind on its AI in 2025. Apptronik has since moved to Apollo 2 as its data-collection platform, with Apollo 3 named as the first true commercial product.
notable: Force-controlled linear actuators for human-safe operation
